title: William Eustis (Secretary of War) → Joel Barlow, letter in code on Henry Wilson's secret arms export from Ostend
correspondents: William Eustis → Joel Barlow (US minister to France)
shelfmark: William L. Clements Library, War of 1812 collection, 1806-1860 (M-855), Box 2, 1812 Sept 25
status: Finding aid: "In code [directs Joel Barlow, an American agent abroad, to assist Henry Wilson. Wilson will secretly export arms to the United States from Ostend in Belgium]". The bracketed summary may come from a docket or a clear passage; no decipherment noted. Barlow left Paris for Vilna in Oct 1812 and died 26 Dec 1812, so the letter may never have been read. Not in the repo; not on DECODE.
why: A War Department order for covert arms purchases in Europe in the first months of the War of 1812, probably in the State Department code issued to Barlow.
verify: Request the 2-page scan; test the Barlow 1811 code, whose interlinear decipherment is at NARA M34 vol. 16 fr. 0011 (research/nara_triage_a/README.md), and the Monroe/Pinkney State Department codes; check the Eustis letter book (NARA RG 107, M6) for a clear file copy.
prior_art: open (checked 28 Oct 2026: web search Eustis/Barlow/Henry Wilson/Ostend; Founders Online Madison 1812 letters - not found)
